macro.reasoning: The engine is at cycle 97 with 50 cycles of sensor history. Multiple sensors (2, 3, 4, 7, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 20, 21) show persistent anomalies exceeding 2-3 rolling standard deviations, indicating active degradation. In the CMAPSS dataset, RUL typically starts at 125 for healthy engines and decreases by 1 per cycle once degradation begins. Given the sustained multi-sensor anomalies throughout the observed window, degradation likely started around cycle 69 (125 - 28 = 97), yielding a remaining useful life of approximately 28 cycles.
